overview.description: The Baron SMID Cap ETF (BCSM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking capital appreciation through investments in US small- and mid-cap companies. Holdings include depositary receipts. BCSM was launched on Dec 15, 2025 and is issued by Baron.
